"""Check captured identities, original native denominators and owned cleanup."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import docker
ROOT = Path('/tmp/codenib-matched-pilot-20261027')
DEST = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit/docs/experiments')
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
summary = json.loads((DEST / 'codegraph_matched_execution_v1.json').read_text())
binding = json.loads((ROOT / 'execution-binding-v1.json').read_text())
expected_adapter = binding['files']['/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit/scripts/contextbench_verified.py']
records = []
client = docker.from_env(timeout=120)
absent = []
for item in summary['workflows']:
    row = item['workflow']
    index, case, arm = row['workflow_index'], row['instance_id'], row['arm']
    folder = ROOT / 'matched-runs-v1' / f'{index:02d}-{case}-{arm}'
    run = json.loads((folder / 'receipt.json').read_text())
    assert all(c['removed'] for c in run['cleanup'])
    for c in run['cleanup']:
        try:
            client.containers.get(c['id'])
        except docker.errors.NotFound:
            absent.append(c['id'])
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Owned workflow container still exists')
    target = ROOT / 'matched-native-grades-v1' / folder.name / 'grade'
    config = json.loads((target / 'config.json').read_text())
    result = json.loads((target / 'resolution.json').read_text())
    assert config['adapter_sha256'] == expected_adapter
    assert config['native_architecture'] == 'arm64'
    assert result['owned_container_removed']
    observed = result['observed_container_limits']
    assert observed['network_disabled'] is True and observed['network_mode'] == 'none'
    assert observed['memory_bytes'] == 4 * 1024**3
    assert observed['nano_cpus'] == 2_000_000_000 and observed['pids_limit'] == 256
    try:
        client.containers.get(result['container'])
    except docker.errors.NotFound:
        absent.append(result['container'])
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Owned native grading container still exists')
    if case == 'pytest-dev__pytest-5809':
        control = ROOT / 'native-controls-arm64-pytest-v3' / case / 'reference/grade/resolution.json'
    else:
        control = ROOT / 'native-controls-arm64-v1' / case / 'reference/grade/resolution.json'
    original = json.loads(control.read_text())['native_report'][case]['tests_status']
    current = result['native_report'][case]['tests_status']
    denominators = {}
    for group in original:
        expected = set(original[group]['success']) | set(original[group]['failure'])
        actual = set(current[group]['success']) | set(current[group]['failure'])
        assert actual == expected, (index, group)
        denominators[group] = len(actual)
    records.append({'workflow_index': index, 'native_adapter_sha256': config['adapter_sha256'],
                    'image_id': config['image_id'], 'original_selected_denominators': denominators,
                    'observed_limits_verified': True, 'owned_cleanup_verified': True})
client.close()
assert len(absent) == len(set(absent)) == 36
value = {'scope': 'Post-run read-only identity/denominator/cleanup audit; no model calls or score changes.',
         'implementation': {'sha256': sha(Path(__file__)), 'text': Path(__file__).read_text()},
         'workflows': records, 'all_36_owned_containers_absent': True,
         'explanation_acceptance': 'Pending full frozen source-rubric review.'}
out = DEST / 'codegraph_matched_validation_v1.json'
assert not out.exists()
out.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
print('All 12 native adapters/limits/original selected denominators match; all 36 owned containers are absent.')
